hooks.command: jq -re '.tool_input.command | test("(^|[[:space:]])(sudo[[:space:]]+)?nixos-rebuild")' > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Do not use nixos-rebuild. Check a host builds with tn-check <akmon|kvasir|all>; deploy with deploy <akmon|kvasir|all> (it asks for the sudo password, so the user runs it). Never switch this machine to another host's configuration."}}' || true

[ -n "${CI:-}" ] && exit 0; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.edits[0].file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && git add "$f" && git commit -m "auto: update $(basename "$f")"; } 2>/dev/null || true
